claims.content: To close a reversible-lane entrance by executing a sequence of device commands that transition the facility from an open state to a closed state, ensuring safe and controlled access termination.

goal.raw_text: To close a reversible-lane entrance by executing a sequence of device commands that transition the facility from an open state to a closed state, ensuring safe and controlled access termination.

claims.content: Operator
The Operator is authenticated and logged into the RLCS application software.
The Operator has a Command Level security attribute of 'Control' or 'Override', as 'Status Only' users may not issue control commands.
The status of all opposite direction entrance closure devices is known and confirmed to be 'closed' (not 'unknown' or 'open').
The current status of all entrance closure devices in the system is maintained and available at the control unit.

The Operator initiates a command to close the reversible-lane entrance, which triggers the execution of a predefined sequence of device commands (e.g., Barrier Gate, Pop-ups, CMS) as specified in the system's operational rules.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator initiates a command to close the reversible-lane entrance, which triggers the execution of a predefined sequence of device commands (e.g., Barrier Gate, Pop-ups, CMS) as specified in the system's operational rules.

claims.content: The Operator performs a status check of all devices in the system.
The system executes commands to CLOSE Changeable Message Signs (CMS).
The system executes commands to CLOSE Entrance Transverse Pop-ups (EN-Pop-ups).
The system executes commands to CLOSE Wrong Way Transverse Pop-ups (WW-Pop-ups).
The system executes commands to OPEN Barrier Gates to allow vehicles to exit the facility.
If the status of any opposite direction entrance closure device is 'unknown' or 'open', the control system must not attempt to open any entrance closure device.
If a single command does not complete within its specific 'response time window', the system shall report a failure for that command.
If a compound command (group of commands) does not complete within its specific 'response time window', the system shall report a failure for the compound command.
If a device command fails, the Operator may issue an 'Override Command' to temporarily force the status of the device to a known state to allow the operation to continue.

If a device command fails to complete or requires intervention to proceed, the Operator may issue an 'Override Command' to temporarily force the status of the device to a known state for the purpose of completing an operation which otherwise would not be allowed.

If the status of any opposite direction entrance closure device is detected as 'unknown' or 'open' during the process, the control system must not attempt to open any entrance closure device (safety interlock).
If a single command or compound command does not complete within its defined 'response time window', the system shall report a failure for that specific command or group.
The current status of all entrance closure devices in the system is updated to reflect the 'closed' state.
The Barrier Gates are in the open position, allowing vehicles to exit the facility.
A record of the executed commands and their outcomes is stored in the Device Command Log (Entity 10) and/or System Operation Command Log (Entity 35).
